parts.text:
Prepare the cash budget for each of the months of January, February and March 2025.
Workings:

Additional information
Mo wishes to have a cash balance of $80 000 at 31 March 2025.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Calculate the total amount of capital that Mo has to invest on 1 January 2025.

Additional information
Mo is optimistic about his business. He estimates that the sales will increase by 20% every month
in the first year. He also plans to form a limited company in 2026 and is considering preparing a
master budget every year.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Advise Mo whether or not he should prepare a master budget every year. Justify your answer.
